title: French Potato Gratin
description: A classic French dish made with thinly sliced potatoes, cream, and cheese. Perfect for a comforting side dish or main course.
instructions: Arrange a layer of potatoes in the dish.
Sprinkle with norwegian cheese and a pinch of salt.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with cheese on top.
Roll out flaky pastry dough and place over the potatoes.
Cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Bake for 45-50 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Sprinkle fudgy brown sugar over the top and return to oven for an additional 5-10 minutes.
Let cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
